cohort: Two patients born with large myelomeningoceles (MMCs) measuring 10 x 11 cm and 6 x 9 cm, respectively.
finding: The use of a deepithelialized skin flap for the repair of large myelomeningoceles resulted in no post-operative complications at 3-month follow-up in the two reviewed patients, suggesting its potential as an alternative or adjunct to a muscle flap.
